official_sources.title: Department of Home Affairs, immigration and citizenship

notes: Paying for a visa sponsorship or a job offer is not allowed in Australia's sponsored visa programmes.

visa_routes.name: Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189)
visa_routes.summary: Points-tested permanent visa. You need an occupation on the relevant list, a positive skills assessment, competent English and an invitation through SkillSelect.

steps.title: Skills assessment
steps.description: From the assessing authority for your occupation.

steps.title: English test
steps.description: Meet at least competent English; higher scores give more points.

steps.title: Expression of interest in SkillSelect
steps.description: Submit an EOI and wait for an invitation.

steps.title: Apply after invitation
steps.description: Lodge the visa application within the deadline.

requirements.title: Under 45 when invited
requirements.description: You must be under 45 at the time of invitation.

requirements.title: At least competent English
requirements.description: Check the current accepted tests and scores on the Home Affairs page before booking.

requirements.title: Positive skills assessment
requirements.description: From the assessing authority for your nominated occupation.

visa_routes.name: Student visa (subclass 500)
visa_routes.summary: For full-time study at a registered course; needs a confirmation of enrolment, English, funds and health insurance.

steps.title: Health insurance and funds
steps.description: Arrange the required health cover and show enough money.

documents: Proof of funds and health cover

requirements.title: English test, as required
requirements.description: Check the current accepted tests and scores on the Home Affairs page.
